content.comment_body: Hello, it appears the message function in ladder mode isn't working as expected. I'm receiving an error saying the output Q isn't connected, but the ladder editor doesn't show one, even though the help section references it. The function operates correctly in simulation mode, but fails during download. Is anyone else aware of this issue?

Yes, this issue is widely known and frequently discussed here. To resolve it, use the message text again by adding a contact and then connect a relay coil afterwards, not as an output but as an open connector.

Thank you for your response. I might be misunderstanding—how should I do that? I'm unable to attach any contact, whether open or standard. What do you mean by calling the message 'again'? In function block diagram, adding a coil is straightforward and works well. Maybe I'm overlooking something simple. Update: I figured it out. I created a new ladder, placed the message as an open contact, and connected it to a coil, which now allows the download. Appreciate the guidance!

Hello everyone, check this reference: [url] This concern is one of the most commonly raised issues by users globally—'why does the function work during simulation, but fails during download, providing the error about the message text lacking an output.' It's very frustrating!
